subject: The Anthropic bellwether
notes: Private-equity item not extracted as it is not a tech or venture-backed target: Turnspire Capital Partners affiliate acquired Middleby Outdoor (consumer living business). B&G Energy (electrical contractor for data centers) is included as borderline.

stories.headline: Anthropic lists on the Nasdaq; closes first day up about 17% at a $1.27 trillion valuation
stories.quote: watching Anthropic (a company that’s only about five-years-old) close on the Nasdaq to the tune of a valuation of $1.27 trillion (or $1.76 trillion, depending on how you calculate it)
stories.description: AI model maker; Claude Code usage, subscriptions and enterprise deals

facts.text: Closed first day on the Nasdaq at a valuation of $1.27 trillion, or $1.76 trillion depending on the calculation.
facts.quote: close on the Nasdaq to the tune of a valuation of $1.27 trillion (or $1.76 trillion, depending on how you calculate it)

facts.text: Shares peaked at a valuation above $2 trillion, then closed up about 17%.
facts.quote: shares soared initially to a peak valuation above $2 trillion before dropping and eventually closing up about 17%

facts.text: Broader market fell on the day: Nasdaq down 2.25%, Dow down 2.19% at close.
facts.quote: the market bristled with volatility, ultimately with the Nasdaq down 2.25% and the Dow down 2.19% at close

facts.text: Per PitchBook, Anthropic has over 400 venture backers and no VC holds more than 5%.
facts.quote: per PitchBook, the company has over 400 venture backers and no VC has an over 5% stake

facts.text: Iconiq invested over $6 billion in Anthropic and had a roughly 2% stake in the last round, per a source.
facts.quote: Iconiq, which invested over $6 billion in Anthropic and had a roughly 2% stake in the company’s last round, a source familiar with the matter confirmed

stories.headline: Lightspeed led Anthropic's Series E (cited as background)
stories.quote: Lightspeed, which has backed Anthropic since 2023 and led the company’s Series E with the firm’s largest-ever single check
stories.description: AI model maker; Claude Code usage, subscriptions and enterprise deals

stories.headline: Tiberius Aerospace raises $85M Series A led by Lakestar and Rochefort Asset Management
stories.quote: Tiberius Aerospace, a Newport Beach, Calif.-based developer of long-range precision munitions, raised $85 million in Series A funding. Lakestar and RochefortAsset Management led the round

stories.headline: Boba Bhai raises $18M Series B from Left Lane Capital and existing investors
stories.quote: Boba Bhai, a Bengaluru, India-based bubble tea and Korean street food chain, raised $18 million in Series B funding from Left Lane Capital and existing investors.
stories.description: Bubble tea and Korean street food chain

stories.headline: Sequel.io raises $15M Series B led by Sorenson Capital
stories.quote: Sequel.io, a San Francisco-based company that helps marketers use video and website engagement data to understand and reach their audiences, raised $15 million in Series B funding. SorensonCapital led the round
stories.description: Helps marketers use video and website engagement data to reach audiences

stories.headline: Metano raises $12M seed led by Sierra Ventures
stories.quote: Metano, a San Jose, Calif.-based startup that helps enterprises discover, monitor and secure AI agents across devices, cloud infrastructure and software-as-a-service applications, raised $12 million in seed funding. SierraVentures led the round
stories.description: Helps enterprises discover, monitor and secure AI agents

stories.headline: Nodal Networks raises $11.3M seed led by Eniac Ventures
stories.quote: Nodal Networks, a Los Angeles-based startup that builds AI software to help container terminals at ports and rail hubs predict congestion and plan cargo operations, raised $11.3 million in seed funding. EniacVentures led the round
stories.description: AI software for container terminals to predict congestion, plan cargo operations

stories.headline: Modern Industrials raises $6M seed led by Glasswing Ventures and TMV
stories.quote: Modern Industrials, a New York City-based startup that builds custom AI agents for manufacturers and distributors, raised $6 million in seed funding. GlasswingVentures and TMV led the round
stories.description: Builds custom AI agents for manufacturers and distributors

stories.headline: Tesorai raises $5.3M seed from Perplexity Fund, IQT, SouthCentral Ventures and others
stories.quote: Tesorai, a San Diego-based startup that uses AI to make raw life sciences research data searchable and comparable across studies, raised $5.3 million in seed funding from Perplexity Fund, IQT, SouthCentralVentures, and others.
stories.description: Uses AI to make raw life sciences research data searchable

stories.headline: Wilgot raises $3M (SEK 30M) seed led by Industrifonden
stories.quote: Wilgot, a Stockholm-based startup that helps brands make their products easier for AI shopping assistants to find and recommend, raised $3 million (SEK 30 million) in seed funding. Industrifonden led the round
stories.description: Helps brands make products findable by AI shopping assistants

facts.text: The issue gives the amount as $3 million, with SEK 30 million in brackets.
facts.quote: raised $3 million (SEK 30 million) in seed funding

stories.headline: Gimv agrees to acquire a majority stake in SpiraTec; terms not disclosed
stories.quote: SpiraTec, a Speyer, Germany-based provider of industrial automation, IT and engineering services for pharmaceutical, chemical and other process manufacturers. Financial terms were not disclosed.
stories.description: Industrial automation, IT and engineering services for process manufacturers

stories.headline: Promera, backed by Angeles Equity Partners, acquires B&G Energy; terms not disclosed
stories.quote: B&G Energy, an Armagh, Northern Ireland-based electrical contractor that installs critical power systems for data centers. Financial terms were not disclosed.
stories.description: Electrical contractor installing critical power systems for data centers
